info.title: Rental Platform API
info.description: Customer, payment and admin API (MD §4). All list endpoints are paginated. All money fields are integer minor units with a `currency_code`. Send `Accept: application/json`; `Accept-Language` (en, ar, hi, es, de) picks the language of messages when not signed in; a signed-in user's own language wins. Business-rule refusals (vehicle unavailable, illegal status change, invalid coupon, …) return 422 `{message}`.

tags.name: Partner
tags.description: Vehicle owners (MD §7.9). Only where the partner feature is on: the global `features.partner` setting and the user's country pack. The platform keeps each vehicle's commission on the rental net of tax; the rest is the partner's, posted when a booking settles. Payouts are paid manually by the admin in batches.

tags.name: Staff
tags.description: Staff app (MD §7.10). Staff role only, scoped to the staff member's branch (set by the admin; without one every call is 422). Handover and return need at least 4 photos, the odometer and the fuel level; damages found at return are reported for the admin to approve or waive.

tags.name: Investor
tags.description: Investor module (Phase 11): behind the global flag and the country pack. KYC approval and the current risk disclosure are required before investing; money comes in by bank transfer, confirmed by the admin.

post.summary: Sign in with the SMS code
post.description: Codes expire after 5 minutes, are single-use, and lock after 5 wrong attempts.

post.summary: Email a password reset link
post.description: Always answers the same way, whether or not the address is registered. The link opens the website page /reset-password/{token}?email=… (valid 60 minutes, one email per address per minute). Throttle 5/min.

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset email
post.description: Signs the account out of every app (all its API tokens are revoked); sign in again with the new password. A token works once. Throttle 10/min.
